name: 分组颜色
desc: 左栏每个分组行有颜色圆点（没有颜色的分组自动分配随机色、新建分组自带随机色、「全部任务」用等宽占位对齐）；⋯ 菜单「颜色」打开色板（10 个预设色 + 随机颜色），选色后圆点与「全部任务」视图里任务副标题前的分组颜色点同步、并落盘；只在「全部任务」视图下显示任务上的分组颜色点

steps.eval: if (typeof T === 'undefined') { window.T = {}; } T.wipe = async () => { const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const s = getStorage('conjure-todo-app-test'); sessionStorage.setItem('__todo_store_id', JSON.stringify({ id: 'conjure-todo-app-test', exp: Date.now() + 600000 })); const K = '__todo_test_backup_v1'; if (localStorage.getItem('__todo_test_dirty') === '1') { const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(K) || 'null'); if (o) { if (o.todos) await s.setItem('todos', o.todos); if (o.groups) await s.setItem('groups', o.groups); if (o.ui) await s.setItem('ui', o.ui); } } const snap = { todos: await s.getItem('todos'), groups: await s.getItem('groups'), ui: await s.getItem('ui') }; localStorage.setItem(K, JSON.stringify(snap)); localStorage.setItem('__todo_test_dirty', '1'); await s.removeItem('todos'); await s.removeItem('groups'); await s.removeItem('ui'); sessionStorage.removeItem('todo-ui-state'); return 'wiped, backup todos=' + (snap.todos ? snap.todos.length : 0); }; return await T.wipe();

if (typeof T === 'undefined') { window.T = {}; } T.q = (s) => { const p = document.querySelector('o-page'); const r = p && p.shadowRoot; return r ? Array.from(r.querySelectorAll(s)) : []; }; T.ready = async (sel, ms) => { const n = Math.ceil((ms || 3000) / 100); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { if (T.q(sel).length) return true; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } throw new Error('页面就绪超时，找不到 ' + sel); }; T.tx = (el) => el.textContent.trim(); T.click = (el) => { if (!el) throw new Error('元素不存在'); const b = el.shadowRoot && el.shadowRoot.querySelector('button'); (b || el).click(); return true; }; T.byText = (sel, t) => T.q(sel).find((e) => T.tx(e) === t) || null; T.btn = (t) => T.click(T.byText('st-button', t)); T.dlg = () => T.q('st-dialog').find((d) => d.hasAttribute('open')) || null; T.dlgBtn = (t) => { const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('当前没有打开的弹窗'); const b = Array.from(d.querySelectorAll('st-button')).find((x) => T.tx(x) === t); if (!b) throw new Error('弹窗里找不到按钮：' + t); return T.click(b); }; T.wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms || 300)); T.NL = String.fromCharCode(10); T.setVal = (el, v) => { if (!el) throw new Error('输入元素不存在'); el.value = v; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return true; }; T.row = (name) => { const g = T.q('.gitem').find((x) => T.tx(x.querySelector('.gname')) === name); if (!g) throw new Error('找不到分组：' + name); return g; }; T.gdot = (name) => { const d = T.row(name).querySelector('.gdot'); if (!d) throw new Error('分组行缺少颜色圆点：' + name); return getComputedStyle(d).backgroundColor; }; T.newGroup = async (name) => { T.btn('新建分组'); await T.wait(350); T.setVal(T.dlg().querySelector('.dialog-input'), name); await T.wait(250); T.dlgBtn('创建'); await T.wait(450); return true; }; T.addTask = async (title, desc) => { T.btn('添加任务'); await T.wait(350); const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('添加弹窗未打开'); T.setVal(d.querySelector('.dialog-field'), desc ? title + T.NL + desc : title); await T.wait(250); T.dlgBtn('添加'); await T.wait(400); return true; }; T.pickGroup = (name) => { T.row(name).querySelector('.gname').click(); return true; }; T.openColor = async (name) => { const r = T.row(name); T.click(r.querySelector('st-menu st-icon-button')); await T.wait(); const mi = Array.from(r.querySelectorAll('st-menu-item')).find((m) => T.tx(m) === '颜色'); if (!mi) throw new Error('分组菜单里找不到「颜色」'); T.click(mi); await T.wait(400); if (!T.dlg()) throw new Error('「颜色」应打开颜色弹窗'); return true; }; T.swatch = (title) => { const s = T.dlg().querySelectorAll('.swatch'); const b = Array.from(s).find((x) => x.getAttribute('title') === title); if (!b) throw new Error('色板里找不到：' + title); return b; }; return 'helpers ready';

await T.ready('.add-group-btn'); if (T.q('.gitem .gdot').length !== 1) throw new Error('默认分组应自动分配到颜色（.gdot 数量 1），实际 ' + T.q('.gitem .gdot').length); const defColor = T.gdot('默认'); if (!defColor || defColor === 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)') throw new Error('默认分组的颜色圆点没有颜色：' + defColor); const ghost = T.row('全部任务').querySelector('.gdot-ghost'); if (!ghost || ghost.getBoundingClientRect().width !== 10) throw new Error('「全部任务」行应有等宽占位保持对齐'); await T.newGroup('工作'); const workColor = T.gdot('工作'); if (workColor === defColor) throw new Error('新分组应自带一个与已有分组不同的随机色'); const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const groups = await getStorage('conjure-todo-app-test').getItem('groups'); if (!(groups || []).every((g) => typeof g.color === 'string' && g.color)) throw new Error('每个分组的颜色都应落盘：' + JSON.stringify(groups)); return 'ok：分组自动带随机色、全部任务行用占位对齐';

await T.pickGroup('全部任务'); await T.addTask('搬家', ''); const dot = T.q('.list .item')[0].querySelector('.gdot-item'); if (!dot) throw new Error('「全部任务」视图下任务副标题前应有分组颜色点'); if (getComputedStyle(dot).display === 'none') throw new Error('「全部任务」视图下分组颜色点应可见'); if (getComputedStyle(dot).backgroundColor !== T.gdot('默认')) throw new Error('任务上的颜色点应与分组颜色一致'); await T.pickGroup('默认'); await T.wait(350); if (getComputedStyle(T.q('.list .item')[0].querySelector('.gdot-item')).display !== 'none') throw new Error('选中具体分组时不该再显示分组颜色点（都同组）'); await T.pickGroup('全部任务'); await T.wait(350); return 'ok：颜色点只在「全部任务」视图显示';

await T.openColor('默认'); if (T.dlg().querySelector('[slot=headline]').textContent.indexOf('分组颜色：「默认」') === -1) throw new Error('颜色弹窗标题不正确'); if (T.dlg().querySelectorAll('.swatch').length !== 10) throw new Error('色板应有 10 个预设色'); T.click(T.swatch('绿色')); await T.wait(450); if (T.dlg()) throw new Error('选色后颜色弹窗应关闭'); if (T.gdot('默认') !== 'rgb(129, 199, 132)') throw new Error('分组圆点未变成绿色：' + T.gdot('默认')); const itemDot = T.q('.list .item')[0].querySelector('.gdot-item'); if (getComputedStyle(itemDot).backgroundColor !== 'rgb(129, 199, 132)') throw new Error('任务上的分组颜色点未同步'); const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const groups = await getStorage('conjure-todo-app-test').getItem('groups'); const def = (groups || []).find((g) => g.id === 'default'); if (!def || def.color !== '#81c784') throw new Error('颜色未落盘：' + JSON.stringify(def)); await T.openColor('工作'); const before = T.gdot('工作'); T.click(T.byText('st-button', '随机颜色')); await T.wait(450); if (T.gdot('工作') === before) throw new Error('「随机颜色」应换成一个不同的颜色'); return 'ok：色板选色 / 随机色都生效并落盘';

const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const s = getStorage('conjure-todo-app-test'); sessionStorage.removeItem('__todo_store_id'); const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('__todo_test_backup_v1') || 'null'); if (o) { if (o.todos) await s.setItem('todos', o.todos); if (o.groups) await s.setItem('groups', o.groups); if (o.ui) await s.setItem('ui', o.ui); } localStorage.removeItem('__todo_test_dirty'); sessionStorage.removeItem('todo-ui-state'); return 'restored';
